title: Great tour by a great guide
text:
This was a great tour and it was made great by our tour guide David who was so knowledgeable about the building and history. He made the experience memorable for many years to come. 
The price is amazing for what you get and it’s an hour long which goes by very quickly. 

I cannot recommend it highly enough and would advise anyone to do it. We did it with our two children aged 15 and 12 and they really enjoyed it.
author: K5210JGbenjaminc

title: An outstanding and...
text: An outstanding and fascinating overview of the Biblical narrative displayed around the Sagrada Família. Our tour guide, David, showed enormous passion and remarkable clarity in explaining the stories and history behind the design. His insight helped us truly understand what Antoni Gaudí was striving to achieve in bringing the symbolism to life in such a powerful and poignant way.

title: A tour of Sagrada Família from outside
text:
Our experience exploring Sagrada Família from the outside was truly excellent. The tour took us all the way around the building, with detailed explanations of its history and the meaning behind its architectural elements, which made us appreciate it on a much deeper level.

Our guide, David, was professional and dedicated. He used an iPad to show historical photos and architectural plans, helping us better visualize the evolution of this iconic landmark.
